data.text: Socket.io enables real-time, bidirectional communication between web clients and servers. It falls back to HTTP long-polling when WebSockets are unavailable and supports rooms, broadcasting, and automatic reconnection.

data.title: Installation
data.code:
npm install socket.io socket.io-client
# or
yarn add socket.io socket.io-client

data.title: Client and Server
Compatibility
data.text: Socket.io is not a plain WebSocket implementation. Both client and server must use Socket.io to communicate.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: It handles fallbacks and reconnection automatically
Use it for chat, notifications, and live dashboards
data.takeaway: Socket.io is the easiest way to add real-time features to a JavaScript application.
